title: Open link (open a view)
description: Link that opens a view in the app, e.g. from a Home Assistant notification or automation (doorbell → camera). Fixed because it is stored in users' automations and blueprints: https://<website>/open/<view> (preferred) or the app form <scheme>://open/<view> (officially allowed: for automations on devices without verified universal links or App Links, e.g. Google TV). Both forms behave the same. Views: camera/<entity_id> (a camera entity) and area/<area_id> (hub area UUID or Home Assistant area id). A link only opens a view, it never triggers an action; the profile of the device decides what it may see (hidden cameras and areas open the start screen). On TVs Home Assistant opens the link (Apple TV media_player.play_media url, Google TV remote.turn_on activity) or uses panel_command show_camera.
x-client-rules: Only the brand website or the app scheme (both official) with path /open/ and one of the views; unknown views open the start screen (reserved for later views, never an action).
Never switch, confirm or start anything from a link; picture-in-picture starts only by the user or as the platform allows.
Check visibility with the device's profile and areas like a tap in the app; a hidden or unknown camera/area opens the start screen without a message that names it.
area/<id>: a UUID is a hub area id, otherwise the Home Assistant area id (first hub area with that ha_area_id).
